proofs.race_free:
by
  refine ⟨finalState unitOps (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ()), ?_, ?_⟩
  · show runLaunch unitOps layout geometry fuel program
      (initial layout (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ())) =
      some ((runLaunch unitOps layout geometry fuel program
      (initial layout (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ()))).getD
      (initial layout (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ())))
    have h : runLaunch unitOps layout geometry fuel program
      (initial layout (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ())) =
      some (finalState unitOps (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ())) := by rfl
    rw [h]
    rfl
  · have h : (finalState unitOps (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ())).trace
      = traceData := by rfl
    rw [h]
    decide
proofs.segment_equivalence:
by
  intro input outside
  refine ⟨finalState ops input outside, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show runLaunch ops layout geometry fuel program (initial layout input outside) =
      some ((runLaunch ops layout geometry fuel program (initial layout input outside)).getD
      (initial layout input outside))
    have h : runLaunch ops layout geometry fuel program (initial layout input outside) =
      some (finalState ops input outside) := by rfl
    rw [h]
    rfl
  · have h : (finalState ops input outside).trace = traceData := by rfl
    rw [h]
    decide
  · show extract layout (finalState ops input outside) = some (spec ops input)
    have h : extract layout (finalState ops input outside) =
      extract layout (finalState ops input outside) := rfl
    rw [h]
    have hex : extract layout (finalState ops input outside) =
      some (spec ops input) := by rfl
    exact hex
